prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: small transparent currency icon for a gothic fantasy game, “Shards of the consciousness of Logos”.
Input image 1: existing single-shard icon, the edit target and exact material, palette, lighting and painterly style reference.
Input image 2: user's hand-drawn sketch, a composition and silhouette reference ONLY; do not reproduce its white background or black pen lines.
Primary request: turn the single shard into THREE distinct adjacent broken fragments arranged like the sketch. A broad upward-pointing shard at upper left, a narrow elongated shard to the right, and a broad downward-pointing shard below-left. The three pieces form one compact upright asymmetric cluster. Leave clearly visible empty transparent gaps between them, including a small irregular central opening; they must never touch, overlap or merge into one crystal.
Keep the original icon's bright ivory core, subdued antique-gold fracture edges, muted sage-gray shadow facets, thin darker contours, tiny contour-hugging glow, sculptural hand-painted gothic fantasy look and upper-left lighting. Each shard has two or three broad readable facets. Clear substantial fragments, not tiny chips, dust or wisps. Deliberately simplify grain and detail to read at 24–32 pixels.
Square PNG canvas, entire cluster centered, occupying about 84% height and 66–72% width, modest transparent margin. All three silhouettes fully visible. Render a single currency icon, not a contact sheet.
TRUE transparent RGBA PNG with empty alpha around AND BETWEEN the fragments. No background color, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadow plane, no frame. The core should be opaque and high contrast. No text, faces, eyes, runes, extra particles, starbursts, added fragments, neon colors or polished diamond shapes.
